paper.title_en: Lieb-Robinson bound for one-dimensional continuum fermions
paper.abstract_en: The central difficulty in quantum many-body physics is that the Hilbert space dimension grows exponentially with the total degrees of freedom. A key feature to circumvent this problem is locality, which manifests dynamically through an approximate causal structure in the form of a Lieb-Robinson bound (LRB). LRBs have been proved for quantum spin systems and certain lattice boson systems, but so far never for realistic continuum systems. We present the first LRB that applies to a standard system of one-dimensional continuum fermions. It applies to initial states with controlled moments of local particle number and energy and is thus thermodynamically stable. Our result breaks the main technical barrier that has existed for using the vast locality toolbox on continuum systems.

decision.abstract_zh: 量子多体物理的核心困难在于希尔伯特空间维数随总自由度指数增长。规避这一问题的一个关键特性是局域性，它在动力学上以Lieb-Robinson界（LRB）形式的近似因果结构体现出来。LRB已在量子自旋系统和某些格点玻色子系统得到证明，但迄今从未在现实的连续系统中得到证明。我们给出了首个适用于一维连续费米子标准系统的LRB。它适用于具有受控的局域粒子数和能量矩的初态，因而具有热力学稳定性。我们的结果打破了在连续系统上使用庞大局域性工具箱所存在的主要技术障碍。
